title: Cloud Control authority and ooRexx console boundary
summary: Alchemy Cloud Control (alchemy.cloud-control/0.1) remains authority for cloud RESOURCE and NODE operations. ooRexx Cloud Console is the consistent human, code and Codex interaction facade; Management discovers the cloud specialist dynamically and never inherits provider credentials or CLI syntax.
invariants: ALCHEMY_CLOUD_CONTROL is the cloud RESOURCE/NODE authority already registered by Development Floor; Management does not replace it.
ooRexx Cloud Console owns interaction vocabulary, plan/apply fencing, normalized rendering and workspace-safe argument transport; it is not cloud capability truth.
cloudctl.sh remains a convenience/provider-adapter shortcut and is not the semantic API exposed to Management.
Management discovers the current cloud specialist and composes it with other specialists; it does not dispatch az, gcloud, aws, oci or Vultr syntax directly.
Provider resource handles remain action locators and must not be synthesized into Job-to-Node Allocator nodeId values.
Provider credentials and IAM remain provider authority; changing --workspace or source directory never grants mutation authority.
oorexx_cloud_console_v0.1-dev2 has fake-provider and r13196 qualification but no live-cloud mutation qualification; do not promote fixture evidence into live acceptance.
The next console backend should delegate RESOURCE/NODE operations through alchemy.cloud-control/0.1 while retaining the direct provider backend only as an explicitly selected fixture/operator path.
Legacy multi-peer XTP firewall helpers imply a reusable firewall source-set reconciliation requirement; implement it generically in Cloud Control and keep XTP as the topology/peer authority.
procedure: Resolve the authoritative cloud specialist for the fresh management request.
Present the operation through the common Cloud Console vocabulary when a human, program or Codex caller needs one consistent surface.
Obtain a plan from the Cloud Control authority and preserve exact resource identity, provider context and policy evidence.
Apply only through the normal confirmation, policy and execution-time revalidation path.
Keep provider-native command text as adapter evidence rather than Management semantics.

provenance.claim: Qualified provider-neutral ooRexx human/code/Codex console with plan/apply fencing, workspace-safe argv transport, normalized machine/firewall records and five fake-provider adapters under ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196; no live-cloud mutation qualification.
Development Floor pins alchemy.cloud-control/0.1 and registers ALCHEMY_CLOUD_CONTROL as RESOURCE/NODE authority.

Later Library operator helper demonstrates multi-peer firewall source reconciliation for XTP commissioning; retained as a generic firewall-reconciliation continuation requirement, not as Management semantics.
